definitions.explanation: The point where something is attached to or joins a larger body. Most commonly used for body parts (where a limb meets the torso) but also for plants and other objects.

examples.english: The base of my leg hurts.
I got a blister at the base of my finger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{根|ね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{切|き}り{落|お}とす→切り落とす：28973_kiriotosu⟧。
examples.english: Cut it off from the base of the branch.

notes:
Most frequently used with body parts, especially limbs. The concept is the junction point where one thing grows out of or attaches to another.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{根|ね} (base of the leg / hip joint area)
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{根|ね} (base of the finger)
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{根|ね} (base of the arm / shoulder area)
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{根|ね} (base of a tooth, gum line)
- ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{根|ね} (base of a branch)

Also written as {付|つ}け{根|ね} in some sources. The concept is the point where something is "attached" (⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧) at its "root" (⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧).
